libraries.name: RapidFire
changes: 1.4.1: missile sweeps set GroundCollision.shaped so enemy hits use UnitHitShape bodies (selection circle at its scale).

Families sharing the burst, all at base scale 1: Q Firebrand (nine unmodified Vinz originals, radius 30); W/E/R now use the unmodified Vinz Shots Vol. I / Vol. I Double / Vol. II originals (six colors; other player colors take the nearest hue, gray -> yellow). Per-missile collision from the original mesh bounds: radius 6 (Vol. I, one circle per body at +-15 in the double) and 18 (Vol. II; Green 16.2), centred tip-radius ahead of the origin (tips 47.22 / 64.46 / 58.01). The first sweep starts at the launch point so the lead is not skipped.

Previous 1.3.1: ModelEditor brillo derivatives anchored at X=-1.21 (ShotsTeam/ShotsVolII twelve colors). setColor/clearColor, shoot, shootColor, shootFamily and RapidPair.castFamily API unchanged; shotsModel/backOf removed (no consumers).
2026-10-26: red Vol. I / Vol. II use the X-shifted copies (ShotsAjustados, tip at +radius) with ahead 0; other colors keep the originals.
2026-10-26: flight height = body radius above terrain (Firebrand 30, Vol. I 6, Vol. II 18 / 16.2) instead of 70.

2026-10-26: every Shots color (Vol. I, Double, Vol. II) uses the X-shifted copies ShotsAjustados (tip at +radius); collision advance (ahead/fresh/shifted) removed; ShotsTeam and unshifted originals no longer imported.
2026-10-26: Shots Vol. I Double family (E, Arp2) removed with its side sweeps and dirX/dirY; only single Vol. I (W) and Vol. II (R) remain.

2026-10-28: RapidPair shows Vinz's Windwalk at 'origin' while GroundMotion is artificial (created on burst start, refreshed on family/color change, DestroyEffect on finish); color = the bolt's family palette (walkModelOf). firebrandColor extracted from modelForColor.
1.8.0: every bolt flies RANGE = 1350 along the aim direction; the cast point only gives the direction (before: its distance, capped at 1000).
1.8.1: the burst aims at the point RANGE away in the cast direction (projected from the actor at cast/recast), so facing and shots keep it while the actor moves.
